theme: Peak-summer Kashmir - meadows lush, passes clear, the valley at its greenest as July settles in
season: Peak summer (early July 2026) - the Amarnath Yatra runs 3 July to 28 August, the longest in recent years, so the valley is busy and fully open. Flights landing in Srinagar, every pass and the Z-Morh tunnel clear, the high meadows at Sonamarg and Pahalgam lush and green, and the Dal glass-still and cool at dawn.
campaign_name: Kashmir Green meadows, cool mornings [INR] - 04 Jul 2026
subject: Summer in the valley is green, cool and wide open
